description: The account's full activity trail, newest first — every meaningful action taken by the merchant in their dashboard (actor: user), by you or any other agent via the API (actor: ai, tagged with the API key used), and automatically by gocushy (actor: system — orders paid/failed/refunded). Use it to answer "what changed on my account?", to review your own past actions before making changes, or to brief the merchant on recent account history.
name: get_activity
title: Account activity log
